relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: Acute (30s) exposure of HD10.6 cells to 10 μM TRPV1 agonist capsaicin induced a transient and statistically significant increase in calcium influx

relationships.subject: OD1
relationships.evidence_quote: Scorpion toxin OD1 enhances NaV1.7 activity by inhibiting channel inactivation and increasing peak current

relationships.subject: DAMGO
relationships.evidence_quote: Pre‐treatment with DAMGO for 2 min resulted in a strikingly attenuated calcium influx peak in response to KCl treatment

relationships.subject: inflammatory soup
relationships.evidence_quote: Differentiated HD10.6 cells pre‐incubated with IS for 4 h had a more depolarized resting Vm compared to untreated cells

key_findings: Differentiated human HD10.6 cells express TRPV1, NaV1.7, CGRP, substance P, NK1R and functional mu opioid receptors
Inflammatory soup (bradykinin, PGE2, serotonin, ATP, histamine) excites and peripherally sensitizes HD10.6 cells; AAV9 is taken up by peripheral terminals in microfluidic chambers
